##### Company sets near-term goal of 50 employees could bring up to 1,000 jobs 

By Kelly Hunt

Published: Sep. 3, 2026 at 5:50 PM CDT

WEST MONROE, La. — (KNOE) IES Communications says its new logistics and warehouse facility could create up to 1,000 jobs over time, with a near-term goal of 50 employees by the end of this year.

The company designs technology systems for customers across Louisiana and other markets, including high-performance infrastructure, wireless connectivity and security solutions.

West Monroe Mayor Staci Albritton Mitchell said the facility is having an effect on the community.

“So important and the ripple effect is real because we are feeling it in our community,” Mitchell said. “We are seeing the additional business. We’re seeing the economic impact. We are seeing the jobs created. We are seeing people being able to have a good job, make a living and do better for not only themselves, their family, but our community.”

Online retail liquidation company to open location in St. Peters 

# Online retail liquidation company to open location in St. Peters 

Developing News(First Alert 4)

By First Alert 4 Staff

Published: Jul. 29, 2026 at 5:45 PM CDT

ST. LOUIS, Mo. (First Alert 4) - MAC.BID, an online retail liquidation company, said Wednesday it would be opening a new location in St. Peters. 

The company said the new facility is expected to create more than 70 jobs and will open sometime this fall. 

The Pennsylvania-based company said the new facility will be located at 16060 Spencer Road. 

“We’re excited to become part of the St. Peters and the larger St. Louis Metro community as we open our 30th warehouse,” said Kellen Campbell, co-founder and president of MAC.BID, in a statement to First Alert 4. “We see real opportunity here, for the local economy, for the more than 70 people we’ll hire, and for shoppers across the St. Louis metro area looking for a smarter way to save.”

MAC.BID buys returned and overstocked items from retailers, then puts them up for auction starting at $1. The items then go to the highest bidder, with no reserve price.

A.P. Moller – Maersk is investing $100 million in a new fulfillment hub in Hopedale, Massachusetts, expanding its logistics capacity across the northeastern United States. The 617,000-square-foot facility is expected to begin operations in late August 2026.

Hiring is already underway.

The Hopedale site will serve a major e-commerce customer and support high-volume fulfillment and delivery throughout the Northeast.

At peak capacity, the facility is expected to process as many as 330,000 units per day.

The operation will include advanced conveyor and sortation technology designed to move products through the facility quickly and accurately.

The systems will help Maersk manage large order volumes while maintaining service levels during seasonal peaks and other periods of elevated demand.
